Subject: Stormline Shell is back in stock
Preview: 20k/20k waterproof and breathable. 420 g. Ready when your next trip is.
Body: You know how fast a good shell sells out. The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is restocked — for now.

If you've got a wet-weather trip on the calendar, here's what matters:

• 20,000 mm waterproof rating — keeps rain out during sustained downpours
• 20,000 g/m² breathability — moves sweat out during high-output climbs
• 3-layer laminate construction — holds up through extended wet weather, not just a quick shower
• 420 g — light enough to earn its place in your pack

This is a shell jacket, built for rain management on trail. It's not insulated and not designed as a standalone layer in cold-static conditions.

Stock has moved quickly with each restock. If the Stormline is on your list, now's the time to check sizing.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
